verdict.rationale: Running untrusted code in sandboxes is a fair question for a cloud provider like Railway, but the evidence never mentions hardware isolation (e.g. microVMs) or disposable sandboxes. The closest feature, cloud agents, is described as persistent machines with persistent disks that keep running after you disconnect, which is not ephemeral sandboxing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run untrusted code in hardware-isolated, disposable sandboxes
